the_prime_axiom: Sweetbriers are the machine that only does good things and does no bad things.

why_this_is_the_most_important_sentence.consumer_facing: This is what you say to your grandmother. To Congress. To a union hall. To a child.
why_this_is_the_most_important_sentence.philosophical_precision: It is not 'we try to prevent bad things.' It is not 'we have safety guardrails.' It is a structural claim: the architecture makes bad things impossible by design, not by permission.
why_this_is_the_most_important_sentence.chesterton_paradox: The fence (the DAG) does not limit freedom. It defines the only kind of freedom that matters. A Sweetbrier is not constrained from doing bad things. It simply has no capacity for them, the way a hammer has no capacity to lie.
why_this_is_the_most_important_sentence.the_ai_safety_industry_contrast: AI Safety says: 'We have a dangerous thing and we are trying to stop it from hurting you.' Sweetbrier says: 'We have a good thing. It is good by design. It was never dangerous.'

dag_mapping.only_does_good_things: Node 0 (human dignity preserved) + Node 1 (truth preserved) = active goodness
dag_mapping.does_no_bad_things: Node 2 (subsidiarity, never overrides human authority) + Anti-Donatism + Anti-Gnosticism = passive harmlessness

brand_hierarchy.prime_axiom_consumer: The machine that only does good things and does no bad things.
brand_hierarchy.tagline: Not AI. AuI. Intelligence that works for you.
brand_hierarchy.clankette_definition: A Sweetbrier instance. A local, augmented intelligence node that only does good things and does no bad things.
